Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to recognize that the WebSurfer had already successfully identified the composer (Hans J. Salter) and his death place (Studio City) in the very first search result. Instead of synthesizing this information and moving to the next phase of verification, the Planner initiated a redundant second search with identical instructions to find the composer and death place again. This represents a failure to adapt to available information and an unnecessary repetition of the initial task, leading to a prolonged and inefficient conversation loop.
